name: Pull-Up
steps: Grip a pull-up bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with your palms facing away from you and hang with straight arms.
Engage your lats by drawing your shoulder blades slightly down and brace your core with your legs steady beneath you.
Pull your chest smoothly upward toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly back down to a full straight-arm hang.
tips: Avoid kicking your legs or swinging your torso to force your chin over the bar.
Move through the full range from a controlled dead hang to chin clearly above the bar.
